_comment: Fine-tune SHADeS++ on real EndoMapper video (self-supervised -- no GT depth needed, same photometric-reprojection training as everything else here) to address the color/saturation domain gap diagnosed vs. plain SHADeS (trained on real Hyper-Kvasir tissue) vs. SHADeS++-so-far (trained only on C3VD phantom footage, ~65% lower saturation than real tissue). Resumes from v_tau050_scaled_c4 (best C3VD/C3VDv2 checkpoint so far). Trains on 656 pre-undistorted frames from 5 EndoMapper sequences (prepare_data/cache_endomapper_undistorted.py), none overlapping with the 10 sequences used for evaluation.
